rationale: The failed cluster’s evidence shows that `node $SK validate` exited 0 and printed 'Validation passed', yet the model appears to have interpreted the outcome as a failure. The CLI section currently lacks any description of validate’s exit codes or output formatting. Adding concise output‑behaviour notes will eliminate ambiguity and help the model correctly parse the zero‑error‑zero‑warning scenario.
expected_effect: With explicit documentation of validate’s exit codes and the meaning of '✔ Validation passed', the model will correctly recognise a passing validation and will not confuse zero‑warning success with failure. The ambiguity around the cluster’s validate_failed label is removed.
regression_risk: Low – the edit only adds two lines of explanations about the success/error behaviour of the validate command, without altering any existing command descriptions. All passing workflows that rely on the CLI section continue to function as before.
